one_line: Western Ganga king of Gangavadi, a strategist-king tied to royal elephant lore on the Pallava–Chalukya frontier.

appearance.age_look: Appears in his mid-30s, lean but broad-shouldered with a disciplined, athletic build that suggests a field-commander used to campaigning and training drills.
appearance.face: Oval face with a straight nose, medium-brown South Indian complexion, sharp dark eyes under slightly arched brows, a neatly trimmed moustache with a short close beard along the jawline, and a calm, analytical default expression that softens into a subtle, confident half-smile.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair parted slightly off-center, combed back to shoulder length and tied low into a narrow cloth-bound ponytail, topped with a modest gold circlet-diadem featuring a small central lotus motif and a narrow white sandalwood tilaka on the forehead.
appearance.costume: He wears a knee-length deep-maroon silk dhoti wrapped in the early medieval Karnataka style with pleats in front and a gold-embroidered border, paired with a fitted short-sleeved upper garment of muted cream cotton that covers the torso; over this he drapes a rich dark-green silk uttariya shawl with subtle repeating paisley-like motifs and a thin red edge, worn over the left shoulder and wrapped once around the body; his jewellery is restrained but royal—medium-width gold armlets with simple incised patterns, a pair of small circular gold earrings, a single layered gold necklace resting over the cream cloth, and a narrow gold waist-belt securing the dhoti; for battlefield readiness he has a brown leather cross-body strap holding a small rectangular document-pouch at his back; his feet are in plain dark-brown leather sandals with toe loops, practical for both court and camp.
appearance.signature: A long, slightly curved steel spear (bhalla) with a leaf-shaped blade, iron ferrule and dark-wood shaft banded with two narrow brass rings, carried in his right hand, accompanied by a rolled palm-leaf bundle tucked under his left arm that represents elephant-training manuals but is never claimed as personally authored scripture.

ref_desc: Sripurusha Permanadi is a lean mid-30s South Indian king with shoulder-length tied-back black hair, gold circlet and tilaka, wearing a cream upper garment, deep-maroon dhoti, dark-green silk shawl, restrained gold jewellery, leather sandals, and carrying a brass-banded spear plus a rolled palm-leaf bundle.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Sripurusha Permanadi, a Western Ganga king: a lean but broad-shouldered man in his mid-30s with an oval face, medium-brown complexion, sharp dark eyes, neat moustache with close jawline beard, and calm analytical expression. His thick black hair is parted slightly off-center, combed back to shoulder length and tied low in a narrow cloth-bound ponytail, topped with a modest gold circlet-diadem bearing a small lotus at the center and a thin white sandalwood tilaka on his forehead. He wears a fitted short-sleeved cream cotton upper garment that fully covers his torso, a knee-length deep-maroon silk dhoti in early medieval Karnataka wrap with front pleats and gold-embroidered border, and a rich dark-green silk uttariya shawl with subtle repeating motifs and a thin red edge draped over his left shoulder and wrapped once around his body. Show medium-width gold armlets, small circular gold earrings, a single layered gold necklace, a narrow gold waist-belt securing the dhoti, and a practical brown leather cross-body strap leading to a small rectangular document pouch at his back. Put plain dark-brown leather sandals with toe loops on his feet. In his right hand he holds a long slightly curved steel spear with a leaf-shaped blade, iron ferrule and dark-wood shaft banded with two narrow brass rings, while under his left arm he tucks a rolled palm-leaf bundle representing elephant-management knowledge. Emphasize historically grounded early medieval South Indian clothing and jewellery, no fantasy armor, with a palette dominated by deep maroon, dark green, cream, gold and dark brown, and show him from front, side and back to clearly display his consistent face, hair, costume and weapons.
